data.name: ToolKeyHint
data.value: {0} report(s) are wired into scheduling and you are authorized to run. Other reports are not yet available for scheduling — please query or export them from their own report screens.

data.name: ScheduleDayOfMonthHint
data.value: If set to 29–31, months with fewer days fall back to the last day of that month.

data.name: OutputFormatHint
data.value: Excel keeps column formatting; CSV is easier to import elsewhere.

data.name: RecipientsHint
data.value: Reports are delivered to the recipient's Report Inbox, not by email. Permissions are re-checked at download time, so users who lost access will not receive the file.

data.name: IsActiveHint
data.value: Disabled schedules no longer run. If the owner loses permission the system disables the schedule automatically and records the reason.

data.name: PeriodHint
data.value: Schedules store a rolling period (e.g. "Last month") that is resolved to actual dates on every run — not a fixed date range.

data.name: TargetPlantHint
data.value: The report covers this plant's data only; the period and run time follow this plant's time zone. To schedule for another plant, switch to that plant first.
